summary: An agent card's usage summary folds only the usage claims since the last read instead of the agent's whole usage history, so roster refreshes stop growing with usage history

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers or data rewrites. The incremental read uses the existing claims_subject_kind_index.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digests change. Checkpoint trims keep lifetime usage unchanged, which the kept fold relies on.

compatibility.detail: Usage summaries are unchanged: a kept fold is resumed only when every new usage claim sorts after the last one it folded, and is folded afresh otherwise.

downtime.detail: No startup work; folds are kept in memory as reads make them.

recovery.detail: In-memory only; a restart or rollback folds afresh without changing durable state.
